rows.label: Bash(node scripts/ai.mjs file_text_replace_once)
rows.sample: node scripts/ai.mjs file_text_replace_once js/lyric_video_song_words_timing_preview.mjs "WITHOUT THE VIDEO'S PADDING AND FADES. The video turns a word red a little before it begins so a small mistake is forgiven; that forgiveness would hide the very mistake being looked for here. The rest of the video's rule is kept: a word stays lit until the next word in its line begins, unless the singer stops for a second or more." "EXACTLY AS THE VIDEO LIGHTS IT. The video used to turn a word red a little early and let it go a little late so a small mistake was forgiven; that forgiveness hid the very mistake being looked for here, so once words were placed here by ear the video was made exact as well. When a word is done is one rule for both, lyric_video_word_done."
